earnings.title: Coupang Announces Results for Third Quarter 2026
highlights: Operating (loss) income was $(450) million, a decrease of $612 million from the operating income last year.
Excluding FC fire-related costs, operating (loss) income was $(202) million, a decrease of $364 million from the operating income last year.
Net Revenues of $10 billion, up 7% YoY and 11% on a constant currency basis
Product Commerce Segment Net Revenues of $8.4 billion, up 5% YoY and 8% on a constant currency basis
Developing Offerings Segment Net Revenues of $1.6 billion, up 23% YoY and 27% on a constant currency basis

items.heading: We may experience significant fluctuations in our results of operations.
